summary: Full end-to-end regression of the re-themed Yue Fung site (light premium industrial look, five-tab nav, renamed /api/inquiries). Backend pytest 11/11 pass. Frontend desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844: single H1, section order correct (hero/top → company → capabilities → service → standards → contact → footer), no /api/auth/me calls on public page, no 'Sign in' anywhere, exactly 5 nav tabs with active underline + sections not hidden under floating navbar (section tops ~217-218 vs navbar height ~104). SERVICE PREFILL verified for all four services (cnc-machining, precision-metal-stamping, tooling, plastic-injection-moulding) — clicking the per-card inquiry button scrolls to #contact, auto-opens form and populates select-service with the matching value. Validation: empty submit shows 6 inline errors (contact_name, company, email, service, description, consent); invalid email -> 'Enter a valid business email address'; <10-char description rejected. Happy path: filled form + delivered@resend.dev + .pdf attachment -> 'Uploaded', submit succeeds, success panel shows reference IDs YF-2610-87461 / YF-2610-A4EAE with service label and timestamp. File upload reject: .exe shows 'Unsupported file type' in file list without blocking form. Duplicate-guard not re-verified via UI (hit the 6/hr IP rate limit at HTTP 429 — backend pytest covers the 409 path). Privacy page /privacy renders with placeholder-tag and working back link to /. Static assets: /robots.txt and /llms.txt served as text/plain. SEO head: title, meta description, og:title and Organization JSON-LD all present. Mobile: hamburger opens menu, nav link navigates and closes menu, 0 horizontal overflow. Dashboard: unauth -> signin + google button; admin cookie -> 4 rows, headers include Service + Quantity, detail panel shows interested service/quantity/timeline/description/consent, status update to 'reviewing' succeeds; visitor cookie -> no rows, dashboard-empty shown, no status actions. API gating: GET /api/inquiries 401 (no auth) and 403 (visitor).
critical_code_review_comments: Active-tab visual state relies on an ::after underline (CSS) rather than a class — tests cannot assert on className alone; relying on data-testid + screenshot is sufficient but a data-active attribute would make automation easier.
test_credentials: Seeded sessions from /app/memory/test_credentials.md used as httpOnly session_token cookies and Authorization bearer tokens; both admin and visitor flows worked.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 2 TEST inquiries via UI happy path (refs YF-2610-87461 and YF-2610-A4EAE). Attempted a 3rd via API for duplicate verification but IP rate limit (6/hr) returned 429 for both calls. Dashboard admin table now shows 4 rows total.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The IP rate limit (6 inquiries/hour) will likely still be active for ~1h after this run. If re-testing the UI happy path or 409 duplicate flow, wait for the limiter window to expire or temporarily raise the limit. Clean up TEST_ inquiries in MongoDB inquiries collection if needed. Admin table had 4 rows at end of run; status of the most recent inquiry was updated to 'reviewing'.
